configuration: Float64 matrix-descriptor observable on fixed deterministic three-atom structures, parameters documented in runner.py, SAB_REPEATS=1.
observable: Seeded random-rank probability matrix and physical Ewald row norms.
default_vs_upstream: Adapted from the corresponding official test or example into a self-contained numerical observable; error handling, storage layout, and timing assertions are omitted.
variant: ic/variant changes one active binary64 coordinate from 1.0 to 1.0000000000000004 (two ulps), exercising physical sensitivity without changing the case.
altbuild: none: the Debian image intentionally carries one GCC build; no independent alternative-build floor is available.

evidence.floor_how: No alternative-build floor is available; nominal-versus-variant Docker self-validation supplies the spread recorded in self_validation_spread.

warrant: The physical invariant is the distribution of atom ranks produced by Gaussian perturbations of row norms, not any individual random ordering. Each of nine rank probabilities uses a finalized absolute band of 0.08 for 128 seeded draws, while the three underlying physical row norms use atol 1e-8 and rtol 1e-6. This detects implementations with biased permutation probabilities or incorrect norms without requiring identical random draw order; Docker self-validation supplies the measured spread recorded above; the human finalized this statistical band.
